scope: November 2023 manor house exterior at Hacienda Buena Vista, Ponce. Includes the west veranda and masonry warehouse base, east brick wing and the open upper courtyard. The coffee drying house and other freestanding site buildings are separate structures.

originalReview.notes: The left background shows the manor west elevation with a pale two-story wall, raised balustraded wooden veranda and red corrugated roof. The grey structure in the right foreground is a separate drying building.

quallaSearch.notes: One exact November 2023 Qualla original shows the manor exterior. The photographer dedicated it under CC0. Other cleared Qualla views show the separate drying house and were omitted from the manor input.
